transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I guess… I can’t really shut my brain off anymore. It starts with something small, like a client not getting back to me, and pretty quickly I’m thinking I’m going to lose the contract, fall behind on divorce payments, and… never get back into a real leadership role. It’s just been hard to control.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about several different parts of your life, not just work?

Yeah. It’s not just work. My mind jumps around… contract stuff, mortgage payments, what people in the Bethesda tech scene think of me. Like I’m damaged goods or something.

Even a recruiter taking too long to email back can start feeling like proof that everything in my career is shutting down.
Did these worries start after a particular stressful event?
Yeah… I think it really started after I was fired. That was about thirteen months ago. I did find contract work after that, but the worrying never really let up.
Have you been having sudden panic attacks?
I don’t think so. Not like… out of nowhere attacks. I get really wound up, but I’m not sure I’d call them panic attacks.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve been… worn down, I guess, but “depressed” feels harder to answer.
For the past six months or more, have you been worrying like this on most days?
Yeah… most days, I’d say. It’s been going on since I got fired, about thirteen months ago, and it didn’t really stop even after I found contract work.
Lately, have you been feeling sad or down most days?
I don’t really know. I’ve felt off, I guess, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been sad most days.
Do you often feel restless or keyed up?
Yeah. A lot of the time I feel kind of wound up… like I’m bracing for something. I’ll catch myself pacing or bouncing my leg, even if nothing’s actually going on.
Do these worries feel mostly tied to losing your job, or do they also happen about lots of other things even when they’re not related to that?

It started with the job, but it’s not just that now. My mind jumps around… contract work, mortgage payments, what people in the Bethesda tech world think of me. Even something like a recruiter taking too long to email back can feel like… I don’t know, like everything’s closing down.
Have you been getting much less interest or pleasure from things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure. I mean, I still do some things, but… I guess I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m enjoying them less.
In the past two weeks, have you felt hopeless?
I don’t know… hopeless is a strong word. I’ve felt pretty worn down, but I’m not sure I’d call it hopeless.
When the worrying starts, is it hard for you to stop or control it?

Yeah… it is. That’s kind of why I came in. I can’t really shut it off once it starts. It’ll be something small, like a client not getting back to me, and then pretty quickly I’m thinking I’m going to lose the contract, fall behind on payments, never get back into a real leadership role… it just keeps going.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed nearly every day?
I don’t know… I’ve been stressed and pretty drained, but “depressed nearly every day” — I’m not sure I’d put it that way.
Over the past two weeks, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I still do some of the usual things, but I guess they don’t feel as… easy to enjoy lately. I don’t know if I’d say I’ve lost interest exactly.
If the job loss and divorce situation were fully resolved, do you think these symptoms would mostly go away?
I’m not sure. I’d like to think it would ease up a lot, yeah… but I don’t really know if it would just go away.
In the past two weeks, have you felt sad or down most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t think it’s been most of the day nearly every day. I’ve had low moments, sure, but I’m not sure I’d call it that.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah… most nights, actually. I’ll lie there going over interview answers or looking at the clock at 2 or 3 in the morning. Even if I technically get enough sleep, I wake up feeling like I was on call all night.
Do you feel like you worry more than most people would in your situation?

Probably, yeah. I know there’s real stuff to worry about, but my mind keeps jumping around—from contract work to the mortgage to what people in the Bethesda tech world think of me. Even a delayed email from a recruiter can start feeling like proof my whole career is… closing down.
Do you often feel tired or easily fatigued?
I don’t know… maybe a bit. I feel worn out sometimes, but I haven’t really tracked it.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I’m not sure. I mean… sometimes I reread the same thing a few times, but I don’t know if it’s concentration exactly. I haven’t really paid close attention to it.
